===== dokumentensuche =====
# Use internal base image (includes uv, Python 3.12, Debian bookworm)
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements and install dependencies
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
ENV UV_CACHE_DIR=/app/.cache/uv
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --no-cache --no-dev

# Copy the application code
COPY src/ src/
COPY config/ config/

# Create data directory
RUN mkdir -p data \
    && chown -R 1001:1001 /app

USER 1001:1001 

# Expose the port the app runs on
EXPOSE 8000

# Command to run the application
CMD ["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "uvicorn", "src.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]===== nachforderungen =====
# Use internal Astral uv + Python base image
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements and install dependencies
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    uv sync --no-cache

# Copy the application code
COPY . .

# Set PYTHONPATH for import compatibility
ENV PYTHONPATH="/app/src"

RUN groupadd --gid 1001 appgroup \
&& useradd --uid 1001 --gid 1001 --create-home appuser

# Create data directory
RUN mkdir -p data && chown -R 1001:1001 /app

USER 1001

# Expose the port the app runs on
EXPOSE 8000

# Command to run the application
CMD ["uv", "run", "uvicorn", "src.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
===== kommentar-service =====
# Use internal base image (includes uv, Python 3.12 on Debian bookworm)
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements and install dependencies
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
ENV UV_CACHE_DIR=/app/.cache/uv
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --frozen --no-cache

# Copy the application code
COPY . .

# Create data directory and cache directory with proper permissions
RUN mkdir -p data .cache/uv \
    && chown -R 1001:1001 /app

USER 1001

# Expose the port the app runs on
EXPOSE 8000

# Command to run the application
CMD ["uv", "run", "uvicorn", "src.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
===== ner-extraction =====
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS test-deps

WORKDIR /app

COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
COPY . .

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --no-cache --dev --no-install-project


FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /app

COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --no-cache --no-dev --no-install-project

COPY . .

RUN uv sync --no-cache --no-dev

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Runtime preparation for non-root user
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
RUN mkdir -p /app/.cache/uv \
    && chown -R 1001:1001 /app

ENV HOME=/app
ENV UV_CACHE_DIR=/app/.cache/uv

USER 1001

EXPOSE 8000

CMD ["uv", "run", "--no-dev", "ner-extraction"]
